### system
Solve this VRPBTW instance. Node 0 is the depot; every other node is a customer. Minimize the total Euclidean distance traveled by all vehicles; use as many vehicles as needed. All numbers are integers: coordinates and times are scaled by 1000, demands are in units of capacity/1000. The last four columns give each node's two nearest customers and their distances (n1 d1 n2 d2).

Rules:
- Visit every customer exactly once.
- Routes start at the depot and return to it.
- A positive demand is a delivery, a negative demand a pickup. On each route all deliveries come before any pickup. Total deliveries and total pickups on a route must each stay within the capacity.
- Vehicles leave the depot at time 0 and travel time equals distance. Arrive at each customer no later than its close time; arriving before its open time means waiting until open. Service takes the service time.
- Return to the depot no later than its close time.

Reply with only this JSON: {"routes": [[customer ids of route 1 in order], [route 2], ...]}. Do not write the depot.
